title: American Seitan Burger
description: A classic American-style burger made with seitan instead of beef, topped with lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the seitan burger patty for about 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, toast the buns by grilling or toasting them in a toaster.
Assemble the burger by spreading ketchup and mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, a seitan burger patty, and finally the top bun.
Add cheese slices on top of the patty if desired.
Add sliced onion on top if desired.
